description: Auto-backup - Periodic background task that exports the entire Firebase database as a JSON file and sends it to all admins at a configurable interval. Admin can configure backup interval via Settings.
steps: Add entry to SETTINGS_MAP: _b('💾 Backup Interval') mapped to ('backup_interval_hours', float, 'Enter backup interval in hours (e.g. 24 for daily, 0 to disable):').
Add 'backup_interval_hours' display line in fmt_settings output.

Create async def backup_loop(bot: Bot) background task function (similar pattern to stock_export_loop at line ~7019). It should: (a) read backup_interval_hours from settings, (b) if > 0, fetch all Firebase data (users, orders, vpn_orders, proxy_orders, deposits, products, stocks, coupons, settings), (c) serialize to JSON, (d) send as a document (BufferedInputFile) to each admin with caption showing timestamp and data summary (user count, order count, etc.), (e) sleep for interval hours, (f) handle errors gracefully with logger.error.
Register the backup_loop task in on_startup (line ~7079) alongside _stock_export_task. Add a global _backup_task variable, create the task in on_startup, cancel in on_shutdown.
Add validation in receive_setting: if key is 'backup_interval_hours' and value < 0, reject.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())" passes without errors
backup_loop function exists and follows the stock_export_loop pattern
Backup task is started in on_startup and cancelled in on_shutdown
Admin can configure backup interval via Settings
verification: python3 -c "import ast; tree = ast.parse(open('bot.py').read()); funcs = [n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]; assert 'backup_loop' in funcs; print('Backup function OK')"
findings: All implementation steps completed successfully. backup_loop follows the exact same pattern as stock_export_loop. Syntax validation and function existence check both pass.
